definition.name: bird.timeline.chat.v2
definition.title: bird.timeline.chat.v2
definition.description: Use Bird to return latest tweets from your Following or For You timeline, mentions, user tweets or quoted search. Bare latest/timeline requests ask Following versus For You. Read-only, deterministic exact records and links returned to this chat.

children.name: thread / normalise-thread-invocation
children.title: thread / normalise-thread-invocation
children.description: Validate and normalise the reusable four-field Flight Deck thread invocation contract.

steps.name: retrieve
steps.title: Retrieve tweets
steps.description: Run reusable bounded Bird retrieval; ambiguous timelines clarify Following versus For You.

steps.name: format
steps.title: Format exact tweets
steps.description: Format exact tweet records and safe links without model prose.

steps.name: reply
steps.title: Deliver to chat
steps.description: Return to the validated source thread as the addressed managed agent.

children.name: reply / return-to-thread
children.title: reply / return-to-thread
children.description: Resolve the source Flight Deck thread and post the final Markdown as the configured managed agent.
